name: Plate Armor of Etherealness
description: A suit of plate so pale it looks like moonlight given weight.
body:
## What it does

Once a day, as an action, you can step into the Ethereal Plane for up to 10 minutes, as the etherealness spell does, until you take the armor off or speak the word again.

spells.name: Etherealness
spells.note: lasts 10 minutes, or until you take the armor off
